items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC10 all covered by tests; no extra features added beyond the triage spec (no tag index, no UI surface).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: poFeedback over-length/non-string returns 400 invalid_po_feedback with a detail string; POST/GET paths reuse the existing validated create/list branches, no new unhandled boundary.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Pure JSON API — no SQL, no HTML rendering, no secrets added; poFeedback/tags/leadParentTaskId are stored and echoed as plain strings, never interpreted.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 17 unit tests + 3 E2E tests assert on response bodies and store state (outcomes), not internals; each AC has a happy-path and, where applicable, an error-path case.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: ?tag= filter is O(n) over the already-materialized store.list() array and is applied BEFORE the expensive per-session findManyByUuid filesystem walk (AC9) -- no N+1, no new pagination regression on the pre-existing unpaginated list endpoint.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New sibling test file routes.lead-fields-tag-filter.test.ts is 305 lines, 5 over the 300-line guideline. Forced by Internal Plan Review Trap 2 (the natural home, tasks/__tests__/routes.test.ts, was already at 298/300 and separately bloat-baseline-pinned at 843); a new-file crossing is advisory-only (Group H audit, not the blocking pre-commit hook) and was a conscious mini-plan decision over further fragmenting 17 closely-related AC tests across more files.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer pairs listed in the iterate spec's Affected Boundaries table (patch.ts poFeedback write block <-> sdk-sessions-validate.ts:173-176; helpers.ts readLeadCreateFields <-> sdk-sessions-validate.ts:169-172); not a new boundary, touches_io_boundary did not newly fire; AC3/AC5's store-reload assertions are the round-trip probes.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff returned 'no findings' against the diff.
